body:
event: message
data: {"result":{"tools":[{"name":"adaptive_respond","title":"Adaptive respond","description":"Triage a query and produce a schema-validated adaptive response: a decision on whether to answer directly, ask clarifying questions, or both (mode: answer | clarify | hybrid), with confidence, ambiguity and risk metadata, a tldr, and optional sections, assumptions, alternatives, and risks. When mode is clarify or hybrid, answer the clarifying_questions and call the tool again with those answers in `context`.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":8000,"description":"The question or task to triage and answer."},"context":{"description":"Optional background for the query. On a follow-up call, include your answers to the clarifying_questions from the previous response here to continue the clarify loop.","type":"string","maxLength":8000}},"required":["query"]},"outputSchema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"decision":{"type":"object","properties":{"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["answer","clarify","hybrid"]},"confidence":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},"ambiguity_level":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high"]},"risk_level":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high"]}},"required":["mode","confidence","ambiguity_level","risk_level"],"additionalProperties":false},"clarifying_questions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"answer":{"type":"object","properties":{"tldr":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"sections":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"content":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"required":["title","content"],"additionalProperties":false}},"assumptions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"alternatives":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"condition":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"approach":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"required":["condition","approach"],"additionalProperties":false}},"risks":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["tldr"],"additionalProperties":false},"meta":{"type":"object","properties":{"intent_type":{"type":"string","enum":["informational","analytical","generative","diagnostic","comparative"]},"complexity_score":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":10},"tokens_estimated":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"schema_version":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"required":["intent_type","complexity_score"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["decision","answer","meta"],"additionalProperties":false,"allOf":[{"if":{"properties":{"decision":{"properties":{"mode":{"enum":["clarify","hybrid"]}},"required":["mode"]}},"required":["decision"]},"then":{"required":["clarifying_questions"],"properties":{"clarifying_questions":{"minItems":1}}}}]}}]},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1}
